summary: Digital Asset Acquisition Corp. (DAAQ) filed an 8-K detailing non-redemption agreements with unaffiliated holders of its Class A ordinary shares in connection with its pending business combination with Old Glory Bank. Under the agreements, DAAQ will issue 3.25 non-redemption warrants per share not redeemed, exercisable at $12.00/share for five years post-close, for cash only. The warrants incentivize holders to avoid redemption, reducing trust outflows and supporting deal closure. The transaction involves a Cayman-to-Texas domestication and name change to OGB Financial Company. Watch for shareholder approval and redemptions at the extraordinary general meeting; the risk-arb spread hinges on warrant value versus redemption price.
